evidence.method: Independent local PE range hashing and DER/CMS RSA PKCS1v15 SHA256 verification
evidence.payload: Every original byte identical except PE checksum and security directory; appended certificate region/padding only
evidence.digest: SHA256 excluded checksum, security directory and certificate table; contiguous section layout checked; digest equals SPC DigestInfo
evidence.cms: Signed messageDigest equals SHA256 of embedded SPC SEQUENCE contents (legacy PKCS7, excluding outer tag/length); native content bytes match embedded content; RSA verifies signed SET attributes
evidence.signer: Embedded certificate DER SHA256 matches pinned existing-project identity; CMS serial and native thumbprint match
evidence.trust: Native Authenticode status UnknownError; no trust assertion or trust change
evidence.hardware: No device calls or load verification
